GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. SPECIAL NOTES: This is a RATE CONTRACT and NOT A FIRM COMMITMENT. The financial limit / quantity specifie d in tender is purely tentative and HPCL does not guarantee utilization of any minimum financi al limit nor any minimum quantities of any of the tender / PO line items. HPCL reserves the rig ht to operate / not to operate / not to fully operate any of the schedule or items.

B. HOW TO QUOTE: 1. Vendor is requested to quote their rate as per the required technical specifications, terms and conditions mentioned in the tender documents. In case of technical deviations, vendor should submit the same in the Deviation List, failin g which it shall be construed that all the terms and conditions are acceptable to the vendor. 2. Vendor shall quote unit rate against each line item, which shall be inclusive of all overheads, charges, any other duti es and including applicable taxes (GST) for door delivery basis to HPCL location. 3. Declaration: During bid submission, vendor shall mandatorily upload following declarations: i) Not Banned / Holiday Listing declaration. ii) Land Border Form – I. iii) Additional documents (like NSIC / ISO Certificate / any other relevant documents others than previou s POs/IRN) to substantiate claim towards manufacturer of the offered product. iv) Declaration that the rates quoted are inclusive of all the all overheads, charges, any other duties an d including applicable taxes (GST). v) Any other declarations as per tender. 4. Tender will be evaluated on Overall lowest basis. C. NOTES TO BIDDERS: 1.0 Equipment Details: 1.1 Pump Tag No: 99P02 A/B o Service: LOUP feed pump o Power: 610 kW o Input Speed: 2970 RPM o Output Speed: 19283 RPM o No. of stages: 2 1.2 Pump Tag No: 99P011 A/B o Service: Amine Feed Pump o Power: 340 kW o Input Speed: 2970 RPM o Output Speed: 16706 RPM o No. of stages: 2 2.0 Scope of Supply: 2.1 This tender is floated to develop a rate contract for procurement of Gear assemblies of 99P02 and 99P11 p umps installed at HPCL Mumbai Refinery. 2.2 Vendor to supply the gear internals with 100% interchangeability to existing one, to suit existing bearings, casing and Load condition, so that no modification of any sort would be required during fitment in the exi sting casing and gearbox.

2.3 Vendor to maintain the dimensions, specifications, Metallurgy, clearances and fitments as per the existing gear internals. Vendor can select upgraded metallurgy to increase performance of the assemblies supplie d. Selected Metallurgy shall be informed to HPCL and approval to be taken before starting Manufacturing. 2.4 Shaft ends dimensions will be maintained same as per existing one to facilitate the use of the existing cou plings and impellers. 2.5 To ensure quality product is supplied, Vendor to perform quality checks mentioned below as per latest app licable standards (DIN/ASTM). Vendor while submitting the tender shall provide the applicable standards considered for quality checks. Applicable test certificates are to be provided by vendor at the time of dis patch. 2.6 Raw Material Quality Tests Chemical Composition Ultrasonic Soundness. Microstructural Analysis. Mechanical Properties Test consisting of tensile & impact test. Process Quality Test Dimensional Measurement/Accuracy. Geometrical Parameters – Runout Profile, Helix, Radial runout and Pitch errors. Graphs for profile and helix. Heat Treatment Quality Microstructure Analysis. Case depth. Case hardness. Dye penetration flaw check. 2.7 Vendor to provide Final applicable Quality Assurance Plan (QAP) after finalization of PO, which shall be con sidered for manufacturing of the gear internals. 2.8 Vendor to carry out balancing of all the gear assemblies as per API 610 (ISO 21940-11 Grade G1). Vendor t o carry out high speed balancing of the gear assemblies and provide certificates for the same. In case Hi gh speed balancing is not possible, vendor to carry out low speed balancing of each component and finall y carry out low speed balancing of complete gear assembly. Balancing certificates shall be provided by v endor at the time of dispatch. 2.9 Impeller, impeller nut, Key and coupling and other required components shall be provided by HPCL as a fre e issue to carry out balancing of the gear assemblies. 2.10 Vendor shall return the Impeller, impeller nut, Key, coupling and other required components within 15 days after collection from HPCL workshop. Collection from HPCL workshop, To and Fro transportation and transi t insurance for Collection and delivery of required components for balancing of assemblies shall be in the scope of vendor. 2.11 In case vendor is delivering the material within 15 days after balancing, vendor can dispatch the compone nts given for balancing along with final gear assemblies. It should be loose supply and not assembled with the final delivered material. 2.12 All the gate pass formalities for collection and return of material given as a free issue shall be strictly follo wed. In case of doubt, please contact HPCL representative for clarification. 2.13 After supply of gear internals, HPCL shall install the supplied spares in existing equipment and evaluate th e performance of the equipment. The equipment shall perform as per existing/previous operating conditi ons, radial and axial vibrations or perform better. Any deterioration in performance because of supplied s pares shall be brought to the notice of vendor. Vendor then needs to rectify the issue, without any cost i mplication to HPCL. If this requires sending the spares to vendor works then the cost of the same shall b e in the scope of vendor. No extra charges shall be paid for the rework required to rectify the issues. 2.14 If during assembly any discrepancies in the dimensions are observed, same to be rectified on free of cost basis. Any charges for transportation to be borne by the vendor. 2.15 Vendor to properly pack, apply preservative compound before final dispatch of the material. Necessary pr ecautions shall be mentioned by vendor for long preservation of the supplied material. 2.16 The vendor shall submit cross-sectional drawings of each component along with dimensions to HPCL for re view and approval before material supply. Failure to submit the required drawings shall result in withholding of payment until the documents are provided and accepted by HPCL

2.17 The scope of supply and specification notes mentioned above gives an overall idea of the total job connect ed to the equipment. Vendor to adopt best processes and technology available along with quality checks, which are not included in the scope to provide the best and quality product. 2.18 Vendor shall submit quote against all line items of the tender. Failure to quote for any line item may rende r the offer liable for rejection. 3.0 Delivery Period: 3.1 Supply: Vendor shall supply the materials within 16 weeks from Date of RPO, on Door Delivery basis at Lube Refinery Workshop, Mumbai Refinery, HPCL. 3.2 Vendor to provide detailed cross-sectional drawings along with dimension of each component to HPCL for r eview within 2 weeks from date of LOA/PO whichever is earlier. HPCL will provide comments/approval of d rawings within 1 week of submission of drawings by the Vendor. Vendor shall however ensure that the dr awings submitted contain all relevant details, design calculations etc. and are complete in all respect. Th e number of days considered for drawings submission and approval are included in delivery period. 3.3 HPCL shall not be responsible for any delay, if drawings are not approved due to lack of information/data b y the vendor. The delivery period shall be inclusive of time required for drawings submission and approva l. No delivery extension shall be provided. 3.4 After receipt of material, HPCL shall assemble them. In case there is fitment issue, vendor to carry out rep air and replacement on free of cost basis by taking the impeller and cone to their workshop. 3.5 If HPCL is required for supervisory services during assembly, vendor to depute their service engineer. No e xtra payment shall be paid to vendor. 4.0 Third Party Inspection: 4.1 Required from HPCL approved TPI agencies. 4.2 QAP: The vendor shall submit a detailed Quality Assurance Plan (QAP) for HPCL's review and approval prior to commencement of manufacturing of Gear sets. The proposed QAP shall clearly define the inspection st ages, testing requirements, acceptance criteria, hold/witness points, and documentation to be submitted. The vendor shall commence the manufacturing of Gear sets only after obtaining written approval of the Q AP from HPCL. 5.0 Order Validity: 24 months from the date of LOA/PO, whichever is earlier. Note: Bidders to note that validity is mentioned as delivery period to keep order valid during validity peri od. Delivery timelines shall be as specified in tender document only. 6.0 Payment Terms: As per GeM GTC. 7.0 Guarantee / Warranty: The supplies made against this tender/order shall be fully guaranteed against any manufacturing defects/ poor workmanship/inferior quality etc. for a period of 12 months from the date of usage or 18 months fro m the date of supply whichever is earlier. In case, any defect arises during this period, agency shall repla ce the defective components at no extra cost. Other terms as per GeM GTC. 8.0 Liquidated Damages (LD): 8.1 In the event of delay in delivery of goods for reasons attributable to the Supplier, the Supplier shall be liab le to pay to the Owner for liquidated damages for the period beyond the Contractual Delivery Date (CDD)

. 8.2 A sum equivalent to 0.5 percent of the value of undelivered quantity under the contract for every week or part thereof of the delay, subject to a maximum of 5 percent of the value of undelivered quantity shall co nstitute the agreed Liquidated Damages (LD). For the sake of clarity, the contract value for the purpose o f calculation of Liquidated Damages under this Clause shall mean the basic cost of the undelivered quanti ty only, excluding all taxes, duties, levies, freight and other charges. LD shall be applicable on full comple te week (s) of delay and for fractional days LD shall be applicable on pro-rata, if any. 8.3 It is the responsibility of vendor to arrange for transportation of the items in time so that material is receiv ed at HPCL without any transition delay. The date of receipt of material at workshop shall be considered f or calculation of LD charges, if any. 9.0 Performance Bank Guarantee / Insurance Surety Bond: 9.1 Vendor / contractor shall furnish Performance Bank Guarantee in favour of HPCL or Insurance Surety Bond for Performance Security from Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) regulate d Insurance Company only in favour of HPCL for 5% of contract value valid during the guarantee period mentioned in the tender attachments. 9.2 Vendors are required to submit Bank Guarantee from Nationalized Bank / Scheduled Bank (other than Coo perative bank). The list of Scheduled Banks as per RBI (Schedule II of RBI Act) is available on RBI website at https://m.rbi.org.in/scripts/bs_viewcontent.aspx?Id=3657 From the list available under above link, Bank Guarantees from the following categories are only accepta ble: i) Scheduled Public Sector Banks ii) Scheduled Private Sector Banks iii) Scheduled Foreign banks in India iv) Scheduled Small Finance Banks – AU Small Finance Bank Limited. 9.3 BGs will not be accepted from Payments Bank and Small Finance Bank other than bank(s) specifically ment ioned above. 9.4 In case of submission e-BG by vendor: In addition to regular format, following highlighted para also should be incorporated in appropriate place of e-BG: a) “We…………………the bank hereby under-take that no amendment or changes, if any, to this Bank Gu arantee shall be carried out except with the prior consent of HPCL in writing. b) “Notwithstanding anything contained herein above: i) Our liability under this guarantee shall not exceed Rs. ................ ii) This Bank Guarantee shall be valid upto and including …………… (date); and iii) We are liable to pay the guarantee amount or any part thereof under this Bank Guarantee onl y and only if you serve upon us a written claim or demand (including through NeSL portal or any other mode) on or before the expiry of 60 days from the date of expiry of this guarantee . iv) This Guarantee may be invoked in parts and our liability shall remain for the entire value/ bala nce value of the Guarantee till its expiry.” 9.5 Please note the, following details also for issuance of e-BG: Sl. 11.0 Updating Bank Mandate: This is required only from the successful bidder on whom PO is placed and Bank Details are n ot updated with HPCL / required to be modified at HPCL. Please login to Vendor Self Service Portal (https://vss.hpcl.co.in/vss/login) and confirm if your bank manda te is updated in the system. In case NOT UPDATED, to initiate the bank mandate update process, vendor needs to log in to the VSS Portal and navigate to the "My Profile" tab where the bank mandate option is a vailable. Please upload the following documents: (i) Bank Mandate on Vendor’s letter head in HPCL’s format, duly signed by vendor’s bankers and the authorized signatory of the vendor. (ii) Copy of Cancelled Cheque (iii) Copy of PAN Card (iv) Copy of Board Resolution / Necessary authorization of the signatory signing the bank mandate (v) In case of change in Bank Account details, reason for such change should be given on the letter h ead of the vendor (Applicable only for existing vendors) NOTE: (a) Please refer enclosed manual for bank mandate update procedure. (b) Vendors will have to courier ORIGINAL Bank Mandate Form to HPCL. (c) In case of New Vendor, the above specified documents shall be submitted to Purchase Department. (d) In case of Existing Vendor, the above specified documents shall be submitted to User Department. (e) Upon receipt of the same in original, Bank details shall be updated in our records and One Rupee test p ayment will be processed. (f) Updating bank account details and providing original documents for updation of bank mandate is mand atory to ensure timely payment against Purchase Orders. 12.0 Force Majeure: The following provision shall be read as part of Force Majeure provisions contained in the GeM GTC: “Payment in case of termination due to Force Majeure The Contract Price attributable to the Works performed as at the date of the commencement of the releva nt event of Force Majeure. The Contractor/Seller has no entitlement and Owner/Buyer has no liability for: a) any costs, losses, expenses, damages or the payment of any part of the Contract Price during an event of Force Majeure; and b) any delay costs in any way incurred by the Contractor due to an event of Force Majeure. Time extension for such cases will be worked out appropriately.” 13.0 Dispute Resolution: The dispute resolution and arbitration clauses in the GeM GTC shall not apply for this tender/PO/contract. The parties expressly agree that there does not exist any arbitration clause and arbitration cannot be res orted to in case of disputes or disagreements between the Seller and the Buyer.

The dispute resolution and arbitration clauses in the GeM GTC stands deleted as between Seller and Buye r, and shall stand replaced by the below provision: “DISPUTE RESOLUTION (A) Discussions and Resolution (i) The parties shall attempt to resolve all dispute and difference arising out of or relating to this contract through negotiations in good faith. If any dispute or difference remains unresolved, then all such unresol ved disputes or differences shall be referred to the Executive Director/SBU Head of HPCL of the concerne d department and the Director/ Owner / authorized Senior Official of the contractor/supplier for an amica ble solution. (ii) If any dispute or difference remains unsettled within sixty (60) days from the date on which either Par ty has served a written notice on the other Party making claims and for discussions, then the provisions o f Part B (i.e., Conciliation) of this Clause shall apply. (B) CONCILIATION (i) All disputes and differences covered under the Conciliation Rules, 2019 arising out of or relating to this contract including its performance or interpretation, shall be fully and finally settled through Conciliation as per the Conciliation Rules, 2019 of HPCL, as amended from time to time. (ii) The Conciliation Rules, 2019 of HPCL and any modification thereof shall be binding upon the Parties (iii) The language of the conciliation shall be English; (iv) The governing law of this contract shall be of India. (v) In case the Conciliation fails, or if there are any disputes or differences which are not covered under C onciliation Rules, 2019, then the parties shall be free to take appropriate legal remedies for adjudication of their disputes. (vi) The Courts having jurisdiction over the place where the contract was performed, except for enforcem ent of decree/judgment, shall be the court having jurisdiction to adjudicate the disputes between the part ies.” 14.0 Governing Law / Jurisdiction: The parties agree that GeM GTC clause on Governing Law/Jurisdiction shall stand deleted and replaced as follows: “JURISDICTION The Vendor hereby agrees that the Courts situated in location given in tender header” shall have the juri sdiction to hear and determine all actions and proceedings arising out of this contract.” 15.0 Recovery of Sums Due: The following clause shall be in addition to the provisions of GeM GTC and shall form part of GTC: RECOVERY OF SUMS DUE Whenever any claim against the Vendor/Seller for payment of a sum of money arises out of or under the contract, the Corporation/Buyer shall be entitled to recover such sums from any sum then due or which a t any time thereafter may become due from the Vendor/Seller under this or any other contract with the C

orporation/Buyer and should this sum be not sufficient to cover the recoverable amount, the Vendor/Selle r shall pay to the Corporation/Buyer on demand the balance remaining due. 16.0 Termination/Cancellation and Risk Purchase: In addition to the termination/cancellation provisions contained in GeM GTC, the following provisions shall apply: “CANCELLATION / RISK PURCHASE CLAUSE: a. The Corporation/Buyer reserves the right to cancel this purchase order or any part thereof and shall be entitled to rescind the contract wholly or in part with a written notice to the vendor if: i. The vendor/Seller fails to comply with the terms of this purchase order. ii. The vendor/Seller fails to deliver the goods on time and / or replace the rejected goods promptly. iii. The Vendor/Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. iv. The vendor/Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. v. A receiver is appointed for any of the property owned by the vendor. b. Upon receipt of the saidc ancellation notice, the vendor shall discontinue all work on the Purchase Orde r and matters connected with it. The vendor/Seller is aware that the said goods are required by the Corp oration/Buyer for the ultimate purpose of materials production and that non delivery may cause loss of pr oduction and consequently loss of profit to the Corporation/Buyer. c. Therefore, in case of Termination of the contract, Corporation/Buyer shall have the right to carry out th e unexecuted portion of the supply/work either by themselves or through any other vendor(s)/contractor( s) at the risk and cost of the vendor/Seller/contractor. In view of paucity of time, Corporation/Buyer shall have the right to place such unexecuted portion of the supply/work on any nominated vendor(s)/contract or(s). However, the overall liability of the vendor/Seller/Contractor shall be restricted to 100% of the total contract value. d. The provision of this clause shall not prejudice the right of the Corporation/Buyer from invoking the pro visions of Liquidated Damages.” 17.0 Holiday Listing Guidelines: The guidelines for Holiday Listing as adopted and available on HPCL website shall be applicable to all tenders floated and all Purchase Orders/Contracts placed by HPCL. 18.0 General Terms: All other terms & conditions which are not mentioned either in tender document and / or in specification document shall be as per GeM GTC.
